title: STOP NUKING JIMWORLD
description: Cancels/disables ALL explosions from occurring. (Made for modded creative, is not survival friendly.)
body:
This is a very simple mod that disables/cancels every form of explosion from occurring. It will blow up, show the particles, but no actual explosion will happen.

This could be very useful for multiple things. Kidding, just one specific thing. That would be modded 1.20.1 Forge building experiences, where people named Jesus (AKA Buford) cannot be trusted with nuclear weapons.

(Made with MCreator using literally only 1 procedure. You could actually just do this yourself, and it's what I realized before making this.)
